description: Bounded local-MRT parser and schema smoke before full 10-day parsing.
claim_boundaries: MRT parser smoke is not attack detection or benign labeling.
A parsed row is not external evidence and is not a truth label.
NO_EXPORT presence is propagation-control evidence, not attack truth.
NO_EXPORT absence is not safe evidence.
Ambiguous AS_SET or confederation path endings must not be converted into a guessed origin ASN.
R-MEM-1C does not modify foreground policy and does not train learning.
